reason: one host runs every validator, every endpoint and both nodes, and both nodes run as root
not_openfox: creating each wallet (`tosctl wallet create`), funding it from the zerostate faucet and activating it (`tosctl wallet activate`)
staging the binaries, chain files, tosctl configurations and vaults root-owned (`sudo install`)
the private container runtime and its imported toolchain image
this script's own JSON-RPC reads, used only to verify

root.why: the executor accepts only a runtime socket its own user owns, in a private directory; OpenFox runs the executor as its own child and reads its artifact store, so the provider node runs as the socket's owner, root. The direct transport joins nodes of one user, so the buyer node runs as root too. No permission of the socket, the executor, tosctl or OpenFox was changed.
